manifestName: Ɔkwankyerɛfo Pa Twi Audio Link Manifest

createdFrom.canonicalVoiceLibrary: ƆKWANKYERƐFO PA — CANONICAL VOICE PROMPT & RECORDING LIBRARY
createdFrom.importantLimitation: Repository asset paths, file sizes, blob hashes and text-based transcript claims were inspected. Binary MP3s were not played/decoded during manifest creation, so no recording is marked audio-verified.

purpose: Portable, machine-readable map linking original Twi audio assets to canonical OP01–OP94 prompt IDs and intended IVR states. Store an identical copy in each source folder so tooling/AI can find the rules from either location.
importantIntegrationNote: This file is the linking contract, not executable code by itself. The app/server must be updated to load it, discover files in the configured roots, resolve canonical prompt IDs, and use the same registry in the simulator and VoiceXML generator. Merely copying the file will not automatically change playback.
discoveryRules: Scan all configured roots recursively for supported audio files: .mp3, .wav, .m4a, .ogg, .aac.
Treat filenames as candidates only. Match by exact known filename/alias first, then compare a Twi transcript or human listening against the canonical Twi working script.
Use paths relative to repository root in logs and the manifest; do not hardcode local absolute machine paths.
If the same manifest is found in both Audio_files folders, deduplicate identical manifest content and merge asset discoveries from both folders.
If two different recordings claim the same canonical prompt ID, do not choose one silently. Mark AMBIGUOUS and request audio review.
Never assign a prompt using numeric filename order alone.
Do not silently substitute English audio when a Twi recording is missing, or vice versa.
Preserve original recordings; do not rename, overwrite, delete or convert them during discovery.
Only status VERIFIED may be used as the final production mapping. Transcript-only evidence is not proof that the audio says those words.
For dynamic prompt types, use approved HCI Lab TTS and validated session values; do not play sample names, amounts, phone digits or references from recordings.
Never capture, record, transcribe or request a Mobile Money PIN through the voice call. Direct the user to the official secure handset prompt.

mappingStatuses.VERIFIED: Actual recording listened to/decoded, spoken content and language checked, Twi reviewer approves wording, and file matches intended prompt.
mappingStatuses.TRANSCRIPT_CANDIDATE_NOT_AUDIO_VERIFIED: Repository transcript suggests a likely match, but sound has not been checked.
mappingStatuses.TRANSCRIPT_CANDIDATE_WITH_SCRIPT_DIFFERE: Likely related to the prompt but wording/options differ from canonical script.
mappingStatuses.AMBIGUOUS: Evidence conflicts or one file combines multiple prompt roles; do not auto-play as a canonical prompt.
mappingStatuses.DYNAMIC_TTS_REQUIRED: Dynamic template; use runtime TTS rather than fixed audio.
mappingStatuses.DYNAMIC_SAMPLE_DO_NOT_USE_LIVE: Recording/transcript contains sample-specific transaction data; demo only.
mappingStatuses.MISSING_OR_UNVERIFIED: No suitable verified asset currently identified.
mappingStatuses.REQUIRES_NATIVE_REVIEW: Twi wording or pronunciation needs native-speaker review.

canonicalPromptPolicy.canonicalNamingIsTargetOnly: Do not rename originals automatically. First write a verified alias-to-prompt mapping, then optionally create canonical copies while retaining original source files.

requiredIntegrationBehavior: OP01 plays the welcome-only Twi prompt; then OP02 plays language selection only if the designed flow requires a separate language step. If the existing file combines these, mark it as combined and do not pretend it is two verified files.
Use canonical OP IDs for playback mapping, not Audio_prompt_twi_XX numbering alone.
The current repository map has an apparent mismatch: Audio_prompt_twi_02 is described as network selection but the existing simulator currently uses it for service selection.
Audio_prompt_twi_03 has conflicting labels/transcript claims across repository files; require listening before mapping.

Audio_prompt_twi_06 through Audio_prompt_twi_10 have been described in repository metadata as containing sample recipient/amount/receipt information. Do not use these as live transaction prompts without verifying/removing hard-coded values.
A cancellation prompt must not state that funds were not deducted unless that outcome is confirmed by the payment provider.
Audio playback completion should advance a state only for the active prompt/session; stale completion events must not advance another prompt.
Run typecheck, automated tests, build, and end-to-end English/Twi simulator checks after the application begins loading this manifest.
